captions:
Let's get a quick start on this grid before the world wakes up.
Isla starts her steady morning at the kitchen table, already planning her favorite bookshop escape.

This path seems clear enough, at least for the first few placements.
The train ride offers a brief window of focus, a perfect transition before the day begins.

I can spare just a few minutes here to enjoy this warmth.
A quick stop at the outdoor cafe brings a rare moment of absolute peace under the sun.

Anti-Knight today — knight moves block matching numbers.
Anti-Knight changes the move, so Isla checks the rule before trusting it.

There's the reminder. That's my cue to stop overthinking and close the app.
Just as she settles into the bookshop cafe, a sudden calendar reminder flashes on her screen.

One final look, and then I'm setting this down for the night.
Leaving the puzzle behind, she sets out her mug for tomorrow, ready for a fresh start.
